title: Sample preparation and imaging for large scale 3D spectral confocal imaging of tissues
author: Tarek M. El-Achkar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9avh2e6
materials: Beads are mounted under #1.5 coverglass and cured for 48:00:00 to 96:00:00 Coverglass #1.5 22X22mm Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #12-541-B
In the LASX software select image to unmix. Once a matrix file is generated (.sdm) it may be used again to apply collected images.

steps.title: Initial Sample Mounting
steps.instruction: Mount the sample on an uncharged slide in PBS, using a prepositioned piece of spacer tape to support the coverslip.

substeps.instruction: Gently push the coverslip to the sample.
Seal with rubber cement dispensed from a syringe and 16 G needle.

steps.title: Configure Microscope for Multiphoton Excitation
steps.instruction: Set up the SP8 confocal scan-head mounted upright DM6000 microscope for multiphoton excitation at 910 nm to detect SHG and auto-fluorescence (AF).

substeps.instruction: Use a femtosecond pulsing MaiTai DeepSee laser with EOM modulation.
Use a solid state laser launch providing 405 nm, 488 nm, 552 nm, and 635 nm excitation.
Select objective: 25x 0.95 NA or 20x 0.75 NA Mimm with water immersion for label-free imaging, or 20x 0.75 NA Mimm with Leica immersion oil (RI=1.51) for spectral confocal imaging.
Configure detectors (HyD1, PMT2, HyD3, PMT4) using Leica LASX software v. 3.5.2 build 18963.

steps.title: Configure Emission Path and Scanning
steps.instruction: Set the emission path and scanning parameters for label-free imaging.

substeps.instruction: Open the confocal pinhole and adjust bandpasses on 2 to 4 detectors to collect SHG (~455 nm) and AF.
Use PMTs to avoid detector overloading and data loss.
Configure x, y, and z limits to cover the entire tissue.
Set x and y scan resolution to 0.5-1 µm/pixel and z sampling to 1-2 µm steps.
Set standard galvanometers to 400 Hz with 2x line averaging.
Remove rubber cement and gently lift the coverslip (soaking the slide in PBS may facilitate this).
Wash the sample 1x in Phosphate buffered saline pH 7.4 (PBS) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First Blocking Step
steps.instruction: Block non-specific binding sites using PBSTS (PBST & 10% NDS, Jackson ImmunoResearch Laboratories, Inc. Catalog #017-000-121) for 4–8 hours at room temperature on a rocking platform.

steps.title: Indirect Primary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue in 200 µL staining solution for all indirect detection primary antibodies for 8-16 hours at room temperature on a rocking platform.

steps.title: First Post-Staining Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sample with 2 mL PBST (PBS & 0.1% Triton X-100, MP Biomedicals Catalog #807423) 2 times for a total of 6 hours.

steps.title: Second Blocking Step
steps.instruction: Block non-specific binding sites with PBSTS for 4 to 8 hours at room temperature on a rocking platform.

steps.title: Indirect Secondary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue in 200 µL staining solution for all indirect detection secondary antibodies for 8 to 16 hours at room temperature on a rocking platform.

steps.title: Second Post-Staining Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sample with 2 mL PBST twice for a total of 6 hours.

steps.title: Third Blocking Step
steps.instruction: Block non-specific binding sites with PBSTS for 4 to 8 hours at room temperature on a rocking platform.

steps.title: Directly Conjugated Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue in 200 µL staining solution for all direct detection primary antibodies for 8 to 16 hours at room temperature on a rocking platform.

steps.title: Final Post-Staining Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sample with 2 mL PBST twice for a total of 6 hours.

steps.title: Final Mounting and Sealing
steps.instruction: Mount the tissue on pre-cleaned slides using Prolong Glass or Fluoromount (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #F4680) and Coverglass #1.5 22X22mm (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #12-541-B).

substeps.instruction: Use silicone grease as needed to support the coverslip.
Seal the coverslip to the slide with rubber cement applied via syringe.

steps.title: Configure Microscope for Spectral Confocal Imaging
steps.instruction: Set up the microscope for spectral confocal imaging based on the specific laser power, detector, voltage, gain, and offset requirements.

substeps.instruction: Configure x, y, and z limits to cover the entire tissue.
Set x and y scan resolution to 0.5-1 µm/pixel and z sampling to 1 µm steps.
Set standard galvanometers to 400 Hz.
Configure 16 multispectral channels as 4 sequences of 4 detectors.

steps.title: Prepare Reference Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare CML latex beads (ThermoFisher, cat# C37253) for linear unmixing reference spectra.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 20 µL of beads with 100 µg of fluorophore conjugated secondary overnight.
Centrifuge beads at 1000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature; repeat wash twice.
Dilute and mix individually labeled beads in mounting medium (Prolong Glass or Fluoromount) so that 5-10 beads per fluorophore are visible in a 500 x 500 µm field.

steps.title: Perform Linear Unmixing
steps.instruction: Scan slide-mounted reference beads and perform linear unmixing using Leica LASX software.

substeps.instruction: Scan beads for channels 1-16.
Navigate to 'Process' -> 'Dye Separation' -> 'Channel Dye Separation'.
Select regions of interest including bead intensity and click 'Add' to add to spectra.
Load a saved matrix if applicable.
Navigate to 'Process' -> 'Dye Separation' -> 'Automatic Dye Separation'.
Set fluorescent dyes to '8' and Rescale to 'Per Channel'.
Load the saved matrix.

steps.title: Image Merging and Analysis
steps.instruction: Merge the unmixed confocal dataset and perform 3D cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Merge images in LEICA LASX software.
Enable 'Autostitching', 'Smooth overlap', and 'Linear Blending'.
Perform 3D cytometry using the ImageJ plugin Volumetric Tissue Exploration and Analysis (VTEA).
